history.summary: The Arden is a new leasehold project in D23 (Bukit Panjang, TOP 2026), 2BR 657 sqft at $1.29M / $1,963 psf, 260m from Phoenix LRT. The $1.29M quantum is comfortably in the liquid band, but $1,963 psf is meaningfully above the $1,797 district median and carries new-launch bias.
history.rating_rationale: Strengths: deep 105-txn series, on the value frontier, 2BR (widest tenant pool), and $1.29M quantum in the liquid sweet spot. Concern: $1,963 psf is ~9% above the $1,797 district median and flagged with new-launch bias, so part of the appreciation is already priced in. D23 (Bukit Panjang/Hillview) is OCR with only LRT (not MRT) at the doorstep — modest growth profile. Balanced — a fair entry-level 2BR, not a bargain.
red_flags: $1,963 psf ~9% above district median $1,797; new-launch bias flagged
D23 OCR location served by LRT (Phoenix BP5), not direct MRT
Bukit Panjang/Hillview is a slower-appreciating OCR submarket
catalysts: 260m to Phoenix LRT feeding Bukit Panjang MRT/DTL interchange
$1.29M in the deepest buyer band; efficient 2BR for the widest tenant pool
Brand-new TOP 2026 condition; on the value frontier

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: New-launch premium and OCR/LRT setting cap upside; expect OCR-baseline appreciation (~3.7%) with the developer premium needing to be absorbed first.
